findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Maria Dorothea Stockburger (PID 9DQM-45L) had a son named Andreas Mayer born and baptised 5 September 1812 at Sankt Georgen, Baden. The baptism entry at ark:/61903/1:1:NNXZ-4L3 (image ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CS43-L99T-Q, Image 120 of group 3015626) names parents 'Johann Georg Mayer, Bürger in [Magdalsthal], Rennuß Nachb.' and 'Maria Dorothea uaor geb. Stokburger'; all three godparents are recorded as 'Alle von Rennuß'. The tree couple's two known children — Magdalena (baptised 5 March 1817) and Anna Maria (baptised 9 November 1821) — are both from Oberkirnach, a different hamlet in the same Sankt Georgen parish. Rennuß and Oberkirnach are distinct hamlets; the father's stated hamlet in the 1812 entry does not match the tree couple's hamlet in the 1817 and 1821 entries. The 1812 record belongs to a different Johann Georg Mayer of Rennuß, not to the tree person's husband.
